name: Barbell Snatch-Grip Deadlift
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, sink your hips deeper than a conventional deadlift, and take a wide overhand grip.
Brace your core, tighten your lats and upper back, and pull the slack out of the bar.
Drive powerfully through your feet while keeping the bar close to your shins and thighs until your hips lock out tall.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees under control to return the bar smoothly to the floor.
tips: Keep your upper back firmly extended throughout the pull despite the wider grip and lower hip start.
Push the floor away with your legs first so your hips do not shoot up ahead of your chest.
